title: Matching human behavior does not show a mind

statements.text: A system can have human capacities in some area without any intentionality, as a desk adding machine calculates and understands nothing. The Turing test is behaviorist, and dropping behaviorism removes much of the confusion between simulation and duplication.

sources.quote: The Turing test is typical of the tradition in being unashamedly behavioristic and operationalistic
